mechanism: Pattern Extraction: Given multiple instances, identify shared structure. Replace specific values with variables. {{state}} the invariant that holds across all instances. Test: does pattern predict behavior of new instances? Refine until predictive. The canonical form of {{induction}} in sema's reasoning taxonomy — probable conclusions from specific observations. It employs {{analogy_bridge}} to map specific instances to abstract schemata, validating the invariant across the set.
failure_modes: Overfitting: the extracted pattern includes noise or coincidence from the instances it was drawn from.
Over-generalisation: the rule covers the instances and also cases it should exclude.
invariants: The abstract rule covers every instance it was drawn from.
Tested against instances not used to form it.

parameters.name: min_instances
parameters.description: Instances required before a shared structure counts as a pattern.
